card.text: Young giant planet about 21 au from PDS 70, still forming inside the gap of its disc.

sources.label: Keppler et al. 2018
sources.quote: We detect a point source within the gap of the disk at about 195 mas (about 22 au) projected separation.

introduction.text: PDS 70 b, found in 2018 inside the gap of its star's disc, is a gas giant still forming about 21 au out. It takes about 96 years to orbit.

sources.label: Keppler et al. 2018
sources.quote: We detect a point source within the gap of the disk at about 195 mas (about 22 au) projected separation.

sources.label: Trevascus et al. 2025
sources.quote: The presence of two directly imaged planets, PDS 70 b and c, in the PDS 70 protoplanetary disk provides us a unique opportunity for dynamical mass measurements

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere of the model radius, glowing its own heat. No surface, colour or spin is measured.
